description: This file declares the SessionServerManager class, which implements the ISessionServerManager interface for managing session server lifecycle, configuration, and state transitions within the Rialto server service. It includes method declarations for initialization, starting/stopping the service, setting configuration and state, setting log levels, and handling pings, along with private methods for state switching. The class interacts with various services and manages internal synchronization primitives.

classes.name: SessionServerManager
classes.description: Implements session server management functionalities including initialization, configuration, state management, and service control within the Rialto server.
